They are gesturing excitedly toward the camera, which is reflecting in the mirror. (2) The camera quickly tilts down to the wooden floor and then cuts to an outdoor street scene near a large stadium. A crowd of people is visible in the background, many wearing similar trendy clothing. (3) The couple appears again in an outdoor selfie-style shot, smiling and making peace signs with their hands. Large LED screens behind him display close-up graphics of his face and stylized text overlays. (6) The performer stands on a crane platform that moves over the audience as multicolored confetti rain down from the ceiling. He holds a microphone and interacts with the crowd. (7) Close-up shots of the performer's face on the big screen show him wearing pink-tinted sunglasses and a white cap. He is expressive, smiling and pointing toward the audience.
